exercises.question: Which sentence describes a hypothetical situation? [¿Cuál describe una situación hipotética?]
options: Si tuviera más dinero, invertiría una parte. [If I had more money, I would invest part of it.]
Tengo más dinero. [I have more money.]
Tengo menos dinero. [I have less money.]

exercises.sentence: Si __ más dinero, invertiría una parte. (tener) [If I had more money, I would invest part of it.]

exercises.english: I would save more if I had a higher salary.

sentences: Ahorraría más si tuviera un salario mayor. [I would save more if I had a higher salary.]
Si tuviera más dinero, invertiría una parte. [If I had more money, I would invest part of it.]
No arriesgaría todo mi dinero. [I would not risk all my money.]

exercises.question: Which form follows «si» in this hypothetical structure? [¿Qué forma sigue a «si»?]
options: tuviera [had]
tendría [would have]
tengo [have]

exercises.sentence: ¿Qué __ si perdieras tu trabajo? (hacer) [What would you do if you lost your job?]

template.prompt: Describe what you would do with more money.
template.answer: Si tuviera más dinero, ahorraría una parte e invertiría otra.

template.prompt: Describe one financial risk you would avoid.
template.answer: No arriesgaría todos mis ahorros porque necesitaría dinero disponible.
